entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand only supports a plain (non-windowed) float side today; got a %s-shaped float operand, which cerberus issue #2330 does not yet cover

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'or' between a float-valued and a histogram-valued operand does not support a %s-shaped float operand, which cerberus issue #2333 does not cover
entries.rationale: the root-only leaf recognizer (lowerMixedExpHistogramSetOp) passes allowWindowedFloatSide=true, so this branch only fires on a float side whose RowShapeOf is neither SampleRowShape nor GridWindowRowShape/ReducedWindowRowShape (i.e. HistogramRowShape/MixedRowShape) — believed unreachable through any parseable query today, since the float side already failed isExpHistogramValuedShape before lower() is called on it. A defensive guard against a future histogram-aware float lowering silently mis-projecting through this path, not a live divergence.

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerVectorSetOp's identical check for the float case and lowerExpHistogramSetOp's identical check for the both-histogram case
